data.name: Basvesh
data.long_meaning: Basvesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vasa' which means 'to reside' and 'eshana' which means 'Lord of'. This name is used to denote the Lord of the forest who protects and nurtures all living beings. In Hindu mythology, Basvesh is an incarnation of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and creation.
